# Button with Longest Push Time.

@example The push times are 3, 5, 2 and 4; the 5-second wait came before the push on button 2.
[[7,3],[2,8],[9,10],[4,14]]
=> 2

@example Pushes on buttons 12, 30 and 8 each waited 6 seconds; 8 is the smallest of those labels, though its push comes last.
[[12,6],[5,9],[30,15],[8,21]]
=> 8

@example The first push waited 11 seconds from switch-on, longer than any gap after it.
[[40,11],[2,13],[17,20]]
=> 40

# A single push, at the largest label and time.
[[100000,100000]]
=> 100000

# Push 0 ties a later push and has the smaller label.
[[3,8],[11,9],[20,17]]
=> 3

# Push 0 ties a later push, whose label is smaller.
[[20,8],[11,9],[3,17]]
=> 3

# Push 0 beats the only other push by exactly 1 second...
[[50,6],[2,11]]
=> 50

# ... or loses to it by exactly 1 second.
[[2,5],[50,11]]
=> 50

# Three pushes tie; the smallest label is the middle one.
[[15,4],[1,5],[6,9],[22,10],[30,14]]
=> 6

# The 7-second gap belongs to the push on button 1 that ends it, not to button 8 before it.
[[5,1],[8,2],[1,9],[7,10]]
=> 1

# Button 3's pushes total 12 seconds, more than button 6's single push of 8, yet that 8 is the longest push.
[[3,3],[3,6],[6,14],[3,17],[3,20]]
=> 6

# Button 9 has both of the longest pushes; the smaller labels only have short ones.
[[9,6],[2,7],[9,13],[5,14]]
=> 9

# The last push is by far the longest (99997 seconds, too long for a 16-bit count).
[[1,1],[2,2],[3,3],[4,100000]]
=> 4

# Every push time is 3: the smallest label in the whole record.
[[8,3],[5,6],[13,9],[2,12],[7,15]]
=> 2

# A tie between labels 30000 and 40000; 40000 does not fit a 16-bit signed number.
[[30000,7],[40000,14]]
=> 30000
